NEH 11:1.KJV: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
NEH 11:1.BHSA: וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־הָעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠עָם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גֹורָלֹ֜ות לְהָבִ֣יא׀ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הָעֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָשֶׁ֨בֶת֙ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְתֵ֥שַׁע הַיָּדֹ֖ות בֶּעָרִֽים׃

NEH 11:2.KJV: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
NEH 11:2.BHSA: וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ הָעָ֑ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ פ

NEH 11:3.KJV: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
NEH 11:3.BHSA: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּאֲחֻזָּתֹו֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

NEH 11:4.KJV: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
NEH 11:4.BHSA: וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִבְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן מִבְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִבְּנֵי־פָֽרֶץ׃

NEH 11:5.KJV: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
NEH 11:5.BHSA: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־כָּל־֠חֹזֶה בֶּן־חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן־יֹויָרִ֛יב בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הַשִּׁלֹנִֽי׃

NEH 11:6.KJV: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
NEH 11:6.BHSA: כָּל־בְּנֵי־פֶ֕רֶץ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹ֛ות שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי־חָֽיִל׃ ס

NEH 11:7.KJV: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
NEH 11:7.BHSA: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן־יֹועֵ֡ד בֶּן־פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן־קֹ֨ולָיָ֧ה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה׃

NEH 11:8.KJV: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
NEH 11:8.BHSA: וְאַחֲרָ֖יו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃

NEH 11:9.KJV: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
NEH 11:9.BHSA: וְיֹואֵ֥ל בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וִיהוּדָ֧ה בֶן־הַסְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל־הָעִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה׃ פ

NEH 11:10.KJV: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

NEH 11:11.KJV: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
NEH 11:11.BHSA: שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־צָדֹ֗וק בֶּן־מְרָיֹות֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

NEH 11:12.KJV: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah.
NEH 11:12.BHSA: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤י הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לַבַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַ֠עֲדָיָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן־פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן־אַמְצִ֣י בֶן־זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן־פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃

NEH 11:13.KJV: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
NEH 11:13.BHSA: וְאֶחָיו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְאָבֹ֔ות מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַעֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן־עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמֹ֖ות בֶּן־אִמֵּֽר׃

NEH 11:14.KJV: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
NEH 11:14.BHSA: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ גִּבֹּ֣ורֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וּפָקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־הַגְּדֹולִֽים׃ ס

NEH 11:15.KJV: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
NEH 11:15.BHSA: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בּוּנִּֽי׃

NEH 11:16.KJV: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
NEH 11:16.BHSA: וְשַׁבְּתַ֨י וְיֹוזָבָ֜ד עַל־הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

NEH 11:17.KJV: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
NEH 11:17.BHSA: וּמַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן־מִ֠יכָה בֶּן־זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן־אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַתְּחִלָּה֙ יְהֹודֶ֣ה לַתְּפִלָּ֔ה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְעַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן־שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן־גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־ידיתון׃

NEH 11:18.KJV: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
NEH 11:18.BHSA: כָּל־הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּעִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ פ

NEH 11:19.KJV: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
NEH 11:19.BHSA: וְהַשֹּֽׁועֲרִים֙ עַקּ֣וּב טַלְמֹ֔ון וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֑ים מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃

NEH 11:20.KJV: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
NEH 11:20.BHSA: וּשְׁאָ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּכָל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתֹֽו׃

NEH 11:21.KJV: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
NEH 11:21.BHSA: וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל וְצִיחָ֥א וְגִשְׁפָּ֖א עַל־הַנְּתִינִֽים׃ פ

NEH 11:22.KJV: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
NEH 11:22.BHSA: וּפְקִ֤יד הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עֻזִּ֤י בֶן־בָּנִי֙ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מִיכָ֑א מִבְּנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים לְנֶ֖גֶד מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

NEH 11:23.KJV: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
NEH 11:23.BHSA: כִּֽי־מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲמָנָ֥ה עַל־הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים דְּבַר־יֹ֥ום בְּיֹומֹֽו׃

NEH 11:24.KJV: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
NEH 11:24.BHSA: וּפְתַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶּן־מְשֵֽׁיזַבְאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵי־זֶ֤רַח בֶּן־יְהוּדָה֙ לְיַ֣ד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְכָל־דָּבָ֖ר לָעָֽם׃

NEH 11:25.KJV: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
NEH 11:25.BHSA: וְאֶל־הַחֲצֵרִ֖ים בִּשְׂדֹתָ֑ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ בְּקִרְיַ֤ת הָֽאַרְבַּע֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבְדִיבֹן֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבִֽיקַּבְצְאֵ֖ל וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃

NEH 11:26.KJV: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,

NEH 11:27.KJV: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,

NEH 11:28.KJV: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

NEH 11:29.KJV: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

NEH 11:30.KJV: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
NEH 11:30.BHSA: זָנֹ֤חַ עֲדֻלָּם֙ וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֔ם לָכִישׁ֙ וּשְׂדֹתֶ֔יהָ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ מִבְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֖בַע עַד־גֵּֽיא־הִנֹּֽם׃

NEH 11:31.KJV: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages.
NEH 11:31.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִגָּ֑בַע מִכְמָ֣שׂ וְעַיָּ֔ה וּבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

NEH 11:35.KJV: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

NEH 11:36.KJV: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

records.name: Aaron
records.distinguisher: brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1)

records.name: Ahitub
records.distinguisher: son of Amariah (1CH 6:11), Levite (1CH 6:1), father of Meraioth (1CH 9:11)

records.name: Akkub
records.distinguisher: one of the gatekeepers (1CH 9:17, EZR 2:42, NEH 7:45, NEH 12:25)

records.name: Akkub
records.distinguisher: Levite gatekeeper serving after the return, named with Talmon at the gates

records.name: Asaph
records.distinguisher: son of Berechiah (1CH 6:39), chosen first by lot (1CH 25:9)

records.name: Athaiah
records.distinguisher: son of Uzziah, descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem (NEH 11:4)

records.name: Benjamin
records.distinguisher: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (GEN 35:18)

records.name: Col-hozeh
records.distinguisher: official of the distrct of Mizpah and father of Shallum (NEH 3:15)

records.name: Galal
records.distinguisher: counted among the Levites carried into exile (1CH 9:15)- son of Jeduthun (1CH 9:16)

records.name: Gishpa
records.distinguisher: in charge of the temple servants (NEH 11:21)

records.name: Hashabiah
records.distinguisher: Son of Bunni, father of Azrikam, ancestor of Shemaiah in Nehemiah's day

records.name: Hashabiah
records.distinguisher: son of Jeduthun (1CH 25:3), chosen twelfth by lot (1CH 25:19), descendant of Hebron (1CH 26:30)

records.name: Hilkiah
records.distinguisher: the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9)

records.name: Jozabad
records.distinguisher: Levite present at the counting of the silver, gold, and utensils (EZR 8:33)

records.name: Judah
records.distinguisher: fourth-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:35), son of Leah

records.name: Malchijah
records.distinguisher: a priest, father of Pashhur, forefather of priests who served in Jerusalem after the return (1CH 9:12, NEH 11:12)

records.name: Pashhur
records.distinguisher: a priest, son of Malchijah, forefather of priests who served in Jerusalem after the return (1CH 9:12, NEH 11:12)

records.name: Pethahiah
records.distinguisher: the king's representative in all matters concerning the people (NEH 11:24)

records.name: Shabbethai
records.distinguisher: explained the law to the people (NEH 8:7)

records.name: Shallum
records.distinguisher: son of Zadok (1CH 6:12) and father of Hilkiah (1CH 6:13), Levite (1CH 6:1)

records.name: Talmon
records.distinguisher: one of the gatekeepers (1CH 9:17, EZR 2:42, NEH 7:45, NEH 12:25)

records.name: Uzzi
records.distinguisher: overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem, son of Bani (NEH 11:22)

records.name: Zabdiel
records.distinguisher: overseer of the priests and son of Haggedolim (NEH 11:14)

records.name: Zadok
records.distinguisher: (grand)son of Ahitub and father of Shallum (1CH 6:12)
